text: Risk management is the process of identifying possible problems before they happen. First, you need to identify risks by thinking about what could go wrong in a project. After that, you develop mitigation strategies to reduce the chance or impact of these risks. For example, you might create a backup plan or train your team better. It is also important to have contingency plans in case the worst happens, so you know exactly what to do. Finally, you should keep monitoring the situation, because new risks can appear at any time. Good risk management helps you stay calm and prepared.
